description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_EnumToCSS' which is responsible for transforming HTML attribute values into CSS styles based on predefined enumerations. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library and handles converting attribute values (like 'display' or 'color' options) into corresponding CSS code.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_EnumToCSS
classes.description: A class that converts enumerated attribute values to CSS based on a lookup table, with optional case sensitivity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute name, enumeration to CSS mapping, and case sensitivity setting.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attribute in the input array into CSS using the lookup table, handling case sensitivity and attribute removal.
